entry.title: Reflation: redox-driven atmospheric inflation as tracer of super-Earth geochemistry
entry.content:
Authors: L Cesario, T Lichtenberg, M Attia, H Nicholls... - arXiv preprint arXiv ..., 2026

Abstract: We demonstrate that the redox-sensitivity of mantle outgassing can trigger transient episodes of atmospheric re-inflation in highly irradiated and geochemically-reduced super-Earths, a mechanism we term reflation. Mantle redox governs the outgassing ...
